item.description:

This version bump also seems to be security-relevant. From the GitHub release:

⚠️ Please upgrade to 26.09+ as soon as possible as it includes important security fixes.

This also includes a commit to fix python3Packages.anki-mac-helper, which was broken on master and is required for Darwin builds, which also closes #561508.

AI was used only to add a patch to fix the build for ki, which relied on now-removed APIs. Upstream hasn't received a release in nearly 3 years, so it's probably worth asking whether it's actually worth keeping around anymore?
